title: nvBench 2.0: Resolving Ambiguity in Text-to-Visualization through Stepwise Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of resolving ambiguity in text-to-visualization tasks. It introduces a new benchmark and model for this purpose. While it includes a standard 'Ethic Statement' section, its core research does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
